tactics: have hs := List.sorted_mergeSort trans total (a :: l)
have hm : a ∈ (a :: l).mergeSort le := by simp [List.mem_mergeSort]
obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, h⟩ := List.append_of_mem (show a ∈ (a :: l).mergeSort le by simp [List.mem_mergeSort])

induction l with
